text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the Fan Fest, a<n>school event
where the campus<n>opens to the general public and
various events are held. It's a day<n>filled with joy,
but for Rice Shower...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Of all things, why did it have to<n>be the
marathon?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You'll be okay! You'll get through the<n>race super
easy! Like ZOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. As a stayer, there's no<n>doubt you'll be
able to finish the race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, that's not what I...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she really is here! McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. It would be improper not to<n>participate in
campus events.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Squeee! So cool! That's the star<n>stayer "Best
Actress" for ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: N-now hold on! Who's been calling<n>me that?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My, my. That's the assumed<n>three-time spring
Tenno Sho<n>champion for ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, not you too, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This is a competition. Along-distance race, at that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Please let me focus.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, all right then. I'll just sit<n>back and watch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Why is this happening?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is this not a favorable opportunity?<n>The current
lineup has made this a<n>perfect simulation of the
spring Tenno<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon? But aren't you inju—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have already executed the<n>rehabilitation program.
After running a<n>quick system evaluation, I have
judged myself capable of observing<n>today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice. You said that you would beat<n>McQueen at the
spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am looking forward to measuring<n>your growth.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Time is limited. Only two minutes<n>remain until the
race commences.<n>Preparations must be completed
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-it's about to start?! Good... goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! And please do watch me,<n>Bourbon. I want you
to see how much<n>I've improved.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so, Rice Shower's marathon<n>event begins.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The racers approach the last slope!<n>Who will be the
first to cross the<n>finish line?!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! It's McQueen! McQueen<n>has secured an
incredible first place!

As for the other big contender, Rice<n>Shower... she
finishes in eighth<n>place?! That's quite a ways back.
Pant... pant... No... it can't be!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I couldn't keep up at all! At this rate,<n>I—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Riiice! Good job out there!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff... wheeze... Huh? Where's Rice?

Hm... I could have sworn she was<n>over here a
second ago...
I need to work harder.

As for the other big contender, Rice<n>Shower... she
finishes in a close<n>second!
Pant... pant...
Good job, Rice!

Second place, can you believe it?!<n>We've GOT to
celebrate!
Th-thanks... but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've still got a long way to go...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry, but... I don't want to<n>celebrate yet.
Next time I won't let anyone down!
W-wait. Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I need to work harder.
